newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-ECI Telecom remains buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ECI Telecom remains buy.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said in a report released on Tuesday that it had lowered quarterly earnings estimates for Israel's ECI Telecom Ltd for first-half 1997 but said growth would pick in the second half.
As a result, analyst Ted Kundtz said he was keeping to his earlier earnings forecast of $1.65 a share for the Israeli maker of telecommunications equipment.
The company this week reported earnings per share (EPS) of $1.34 for 1996, after fourth-quarter EPS came one cent under Kundtz's forecast. He maintained ECI's 1-buy rating.

"We do not regard the fourth quarter as indicative of ECI's prospects," he said. "Tone of business remains strong and we are raising our sales growth target to 21 percent from prior 15 percent estimate."
Kundtz said he regarded the recent sell-off in ECI shares as a buying opportunity.
He added that gross margins would remain steady this year and that ECI's Telematics unit would stage a turnaround.
